property_summary: For any caller who is the admin and any new owner address different from the contract itself, calling setOwner(newOwner) must set the public owner to exactly newOwner; the mutant instead always sets owner to address(this), so owner() != newOwner for most inputs.
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = address(this);' so the owner is set to the contract address instead of the argument.
